subject: food-technology
title: Workspace Safety
welcome_lead: Hot pans, sharp knives and slippery floors.
meta_desc: KS3 food: kitchen hazards, knives, hobs, fires.
final_note: The kitchen has many hazards — work safely.

concepts.def: Burn from hot liquid or steam.
Falling on wet or greasy floor.

walkthroughs.body_html: Use oven gloves for hot pans and trays. Turn pan handles inward so no one knocks them. Pour boiling water away from your body to avoid scalds.
Sharp knives are safer than blunt — they don't slip. Use the bridge grip or claw grip. Carry knife pointing down. Never put it loose in soapy water.
If oil catches fire — never water! Use a fire blanket to smother. Wipe spills straight away to prevent slips. Know where the extinguisher is.
